verdict.rationale: Navan's developer portal documents a public API. It uses OAuth 2.0 client-credentials auth and offers retrieval and update endpoints across the expense surface: card transactions, manual expenses, repayments, disputes, custom fields, receipts, webhooks and async job polling. An llms.txt and an MCP server add AI-friendly access paths. Missing for 10: API coverage of the travel booking/trip surface (evidence covers only expense data), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
